HMC-1_strong_external_replication.condition: Full-cohort HMC shows B-A macro-F1 delta of comparable sign and magnitude to Sleep-EDF's own +0.028 (or larger), with a majority of held-out test recordings favoring B, AND the shuffled-EOG control condition remains clearly worse than B (control superiority preserved).
HMC-1_strong_external_replication.implication_if_observed: EOG would be promotable to TIER_A_REPLICATED_SUPPORT and its architecture_implication in results/stage4_scientific_sensor_value_matrix.json could reasonably move from SUPPORTED toward STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_CORE.

HMC-2_near_zero_external_benefit.condition: Full-cohort HMC shows a B-A delta close to zero (e.g. within the seed-to-seed noise band already observed in Sleep-EDF, roughly +/-0.01-0.03 macro-F1) with no clear majority direction across held-out recordings.
HMC-2_near_zero_external_benefit.implication_if_observed: EOG would remain TIER_C_BOUNDED_SUPPORT for external validity - same-dataset support stays TIER_B, but the external claim should downgrade to 'inconclusive at full scale' rather than supportive or negative.

HMC-3_external_negative_result.condition: Full-cohort HMC shows a stable, majority-consistent NEGATIVE B-A delta across held-out recordings (EOG measurably hurts external sleep-stage classification), not attributable to a single-recording artifact.
HMC-3_external_negative_result.implication_if_observed: EOG's architecture candidacy should downgrade toward CONDITIONAL_CANDIDATE or EXPERIMENTAL_CANDIDATE - same-dataset support alone would no longer be sufficient given a real external negative signal, and the burden-vs-evidence case would need re-examination even under a shared-AFE assumption.

A candidate class that drops thoracic BioZ (e.g. MINIMAL_CORE, CORE_PLUS_CONTEXT) therefore cannot be assigned a precise reduced chest-module mass; only the qualitative direction (smaller) is known. Whether EOG's shared-AFE assumption is engineering-confirmed (vs. merely asserted) also remains an open determination per results/stage4_architecture_candidate_classes.json's own text.

FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY.description: Select an architecture now that includes (or excludes) EOG, with an explicit written condition that the HMC full-cohort result may trigger revision.
FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY.what_could_trigger_revision: A stable, majority-consistent NEGATIVE HMC full-cohort result (scenario HMC-3) if EOG was included; OR a strong external-replication result (scenario HMC-1) if EOG was excluded pending more evidence.
FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY.claim_limitations: Any public/jury-facing claim about EOG must cite TIER_B_CONTROLLED_SUPPORT (same-dataset) / TIER_C_BOUNDED_SUPPORT (external) exactly as the claim ledger requires (GATE_C/GATE_G) - never presented as externally validated pending the full-cohort result.

DS-1_sparse_approximately_equals_full.condition: Full-cohort comparison shows sparse (4-channel) EEG performance within a small, consistently-observed margin of full-montage EEG across the majority of subjects, with no subgroup showing a large gap.
DS-1_sparse_approximately_equals_full.implication_if_observed: Would support electrode minimization for the EEG module - a real evidence-based case for a low-channel-count architecture.

DS-2_sparse_materially_worse.condition: Full-cohort comparison shows sparse EEG meaningfully and consistently worse than full montage (a gap well beyond seed/subject noise) across the majority of subjects.
DS-2_sparse_materially_worse.implication_if_observed: Would weaken aggressive EEG channel minimization as a scientifically-supported choice.

DS-3_strong_subject_heterogeneity.condition: Full-cohort comparison shows some subjects with near-equal sparse/full performance and others with a large gap, without a consistent population-level direction.
DS-3_strong_subject_heterogeneity.implication_if_observed: May justify a CONDITIONAL architecture (e.g. adaptive or subject-calibrated channel count) rather than a single universal configuration - this is a real, distinct architecture class worth defining (see results/stage4_architecture_candidate_classes.json).

WAIT.description: Delay the EEG channel-count decision until the full ~65-subject ds003838 cohort comparison completes.
WAIT.benefit: Distinguishes between the three decision-flip scenarios (DS-1 approximate equality supports minimization, DS-2 materially worse weakens it, DS-3 heterogeneity may justify a conditional/adaptive architecture class) - n=3 cannot currently distinguish any of these.
WAIT.cost: results/stage4_science_consumption_manifest.json marks this as: 'n=3; full ~65-subject cohort pending (~93GB/~9.4h additional download quantified, not attempted).' - plus full-cohort training time on top of that download.
WAIT.what_uncertainty_is_removed: Whether aggressive EEG electrode minimization is scientifically supported at the population level, or whether a subject-adaptive channel-count architecture class is warranted instead.

FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY.description: Select a specific EEG channel count now (sparse or full montage), with an explicit condition that the ds003838 full-cohort result may trigger revision.
FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY.what_could_trigger_revision: A materially-worse sparse-EEG result at full cohort (DS-2) if a sparse montage was selected; or strong subject heterogeneity (DS-3) surfacing a need for a conditional/adaptive channel-count class regardless of which fixed count was initially selected.
FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY.claim_limitations: Any claim about electrode-count sufficiency must be scoped to 'n=3 bounded diagnostic, inconclusive by design' (TIER_C_BOUNDED_SUPPORT) - never presented as population-validated minimization.

FREEZE_DESPITE_UNCERTAINTY_WITH_DISCLOSU.description: Freeze the EEG channel-count decision now, without waiting for or conditioning on the ds003838 full-cohort result.
FREEZE_DESPITE_UNCERTAINTY_WITH_DISCLOSU.residual_uncertainty: n=3 is explicitly too small to distinguish approximate equality, material worsening, or strong subject heterogeneity - the population-level electrode-minimization question remains genuinely open at freeze time.
FREEZE_DESPITE_UNCERTAINTY_WITH_DISCLOSU.disclosure_language: The selected EEG channel count reflects an n=3 bounded diagnostic only (TIER_C_BOUNDED_SUPPORT), not a population-validated minimization result; full-cohort evidence that could materially change this conclusion has not been obtained.
FREEZE_DESPITE_UNCERTAINTY_WITH_DISCLOSU.scientific_risk: If the full cohort later shows DS-2 (materially worse) or DS-3 (strong heterogeneity), a frozen fixed-channel-count architecture may need later revision or may have foreclosed a conditional/adaptive design that the evidence would have supported.

potential_dominance.dominance_reason: Tier-A evidence only; no HIGH-decision-sensitivity dependency; lowest sensor count.
EOG's isolated incremental burden (+0.375 mW, +0.4 g) is small; HIGH decision sensitivity to pending HMC full-cohort result (Gate E), not a burden concern.

leg BioZ adds a genuinely new body region + attachment/contact burden (leg_module, 8.431 g, excluded from every base total) for TIER_D_MIXED_OR_FRAGILE evidence (pareto_inputs incremental_value=MIXED, decision_fragility=HIGH); thoracic BioZ adds real, non-trivial power (1.33485 mW - one of the largest single contributors) for MIXED/negative-leaning evidence with no new body region. Per the Science Owner's own governing rule ('low burden does not transform weak evidence into strong evidence'), both warrant scrutiny; confirmed DOMINATED status requires Integration Owner's engineering burden confirmation (module-boundary, electrode counts) that Gate D has not yet closed.

second-site PPG adds a new physical/optical sensing site with real burden (9.018 mW, 28500 bps - both larger than several already-included modalities) for a TIER_E_NEGATIVE_OR_DEPRIORITIZED, consistently-negative result (pareto_inputs incremental_value=NEGATIVE). Wrist temperature/light are TIER_P_PENDING with no governing experiment at all. This class is explicitly exploratory per the Science Owner's own candidate_classes.json, never evidence-supported.

decision_blockers.detail: Arithmetic is independently verified correct (results/independent_engineering_arithmetic_check_day12.json) and every previously-open power/mass/data-rate blocker now has an explicit, separately-labeled value - this is genuine progress over Day-11 Part-2's NOT_READY baseline. However, GATE_D_BURDEN_COMPLETENESS requires burden accounting across body region, contact/electrode count, module count, and attachment/strap burden (not chip/component count alone). Two of the known_unknowns above are NOT bounded (electrode/contact counts are literally absent - None - for 3 of 4 electrode-bearing modalities; the shared-hub-vs-per-module battery boundary is a completely open topology choice with no stated interval either direction) and both could plausibly change how burden compares across candidate classes (e.g. how much leg BioZ or the second PPG site actually cost once module-sharing is resolved; how much any electrode-heavy configuration weighs once montages are frozen). Per the closure-prep master prompt's own Gate D closure logic, CONDITIONALLY_READY requires 'uncertainties are explicitly bounded' - that is not yet true here. NOT_READY is the honest classification; CONDITIONALLY_READY would require converting the electrode-count and module-boundary unknowns into stated bounded ranges first.
what_closes_it: Freeze the module-boundary decision (shared hub vs. per-module electronics/battery) so battery/enclosure/wiring mass and MCU/radio power can be apportioned once per system rather than once per module - OR, short of freezing it, publish a bounded interval (best case shared-hub / worst case per-module) for every multi-module candidate class.

Freeze electrode/contact counts for ECG, EEG main montage, and thoracic/leg BioZ (or publish an explicit bounded range with a stated worst case), matching the precedent already set for EOG's +2-electrode count.

Decompose (or explicitly bound) the chest_module's combined ECG+thoracic-BioZ mass into per-sensor contributions, or accept and disclose that MINIMAL_CORE/CORE_PLUS_CONTEXT's chest-module mass is only qualitatively (not quantitatively) lower than EVIDENCE_EXTENDED's.

Obtain Integration Owner engineering confirmation (not assumption) that EEG+EOG shared-AFE co-location is feasible on the selected AFE part, since results/stage4_architecture_candidate_classes.json itself flags this as an unmade determination.
